title: F9: cross-record reexec_of check in verify
outcome: Verify checks each reexec_of target is a sig_ok hold record with the same envelope_hash, an executed unhold in between, re-executed at most once
acceptance: Hand-built record with reexec_of to a non-hold record -> TAMPER reexec_invalid at that seq
Two records re-executing the same hold -> TAMPER reexec_invalid at the second
Re-exec without an intervening executed unhold action:<record_id> -> TAMPER reexec_invalid; clean hero record OK
summary: New src/ks/verify/reexec.py reexec_pass, wired in core.py before window_pass: reexec_invalid (TAMPER, first_bad = re-exec seq) for non-hold/missing target, non-approval hold, envelope_hash/agent/conn mismatch, second re-exec, no executed manual unhold action:<id> in between. tests/verify/test_reexec.py (7). Local 927 pass; container: 4 fails in tests/runtime/test_recover.py (Alert 'tamper cannot be hard', not mine); smoke OK.
review: [kabir · done] Done. Tried every case on real B3-19 runs: per-record on held_action, plus full verify() on a witnessed W.run with records re-signed by the run's gateway key. All give TAMPER reexec_invalid at the re-exec seq: target is not a hold (seed); same hold re-executed twice (flagged at the second); different conn; no unhold at all; unhold denied; unhold aimed at another hold; unhold after the re-exec; hold with sensitive_field reason; hold record changed to exec; args differ (envelope_hash no longer matches, and integrity also flags it). Hold and re-exec both in the unwitnessed tail: honest run verifies ok (lws 209 < hold 212). Removing the unhold gives reexec_invalid@213; a duplicate re-exec gives reexec_invalid@215. A reexec_of pointing at a later seq or at itself is already refused when the record is parsed. A different agent is blocked by envelope_hash or the integrity check. Local and container runs of tests/verify and tests/containment: 62 passed each. Non-blocking follow-up: verify does not check the re-exec envelope's epoch against the EpochFold (the gateway does, in _control_denial). Verify has no epoch-fence check for any record, so this gap is general.
